keyPoints.en: Topic sentence tells what the paragraph is about.
keyPoints.hi: मुख्य वाक्य बताता है कि अनुच्छेद किस बारे में है।
बातें: विशेषण और तथ्य इस्तेमाल करो।

keyPoints.en: Closing sentence ends with a feeling or summary.
keyPoints.hi: समापन वाक्य भावना या सार पर ख़त्म होता है।

problem.en: Write a short paragraph on "My Pet".

steps.en: Topic sentence: I have a pet dog named Bruno.
steps.hi: मुख्य वाक्य: I have a pet dog named Bruno.

steps.en: Details: colour, food, what he does.
steps.hi: बातें: रंग, खाना, वह क्या करता है।
समापन: तुम कैसा महसूस करते हो।

answer.en: I have a pet dog named Bruno. He is brown and white. He eats rice and milk. He plays with me every evening. I love Bruno very much.
answer.hi: I have a pet dog named Bruno. He is brown and white. He eats rice and milk. He plays with me every evening. I love Bruno very much.

problem.en: Make a better sentence: "I saw a bird."
problem.hi: बेहतर वाक्य बनाओ: "I saw a bird."

answer.en: I saw a small green parrot on the mango tree.
answer.hi: I saw a small green parrot on the mango tree.

answer.en: A group of sentences about one topic
answer.hi: एक विषय पर वाक्यों का समूह

question.en: Write a topic sentence for "My School".
question.hi: "My School" के लिए मुख्य वाक्य लिखो।

answer.en: Example: My school is the best place to learn and play.
answer.hi: उदाहरण: My school is the best place to learn and play.

question.en: What should the last sentence of a paragraph do?
question.hi: अनुच्छेद का आख़िरी वाक्य क्या करे?

answer.en: Close the topic with a feeling or summary
answer.hi: भावना या सार से विषय समाप्त करे

intro.en: A paragraph is a group of sentences about one topic. It starts with a topic sentence, gives 3–4 details, and ends with a closing sentence.
intro.hi: अनुच्छेद (paragraph) एक विषय पर वाक्यों का समूह है। यह मुख्य वाक्य से शुरू होता है, 3–4 बातें बताता है, और एक समापन वाक्य पर ख़त्म होता है।
